case_title: Priti Saraf & Anr. v. State of NCT of Delhi & Anr.
neutral_facts: The case involves a commercial transaction where the accused, a property owner, entered into an agreement to sell with the complainant. The accused mortgaged the property and later breached the agreement, leading to the complainant paying a significant sum. The accused allegedly terminated the agreement and forfeited the earnest money. The complainant filed a complaint, leading to an FIR and charge-sheet against the accused. The High Court quashed the criminal proceedings, considering it a civil dispute. The Supreme Court overturned the High Court's decision, stating that the allegations in the complaint and charge-sheet indicated the commission of an offence under the relevant sections of the IPC.
